name: Armor of Shadow
body:
School abjuration [darkness, shadow]; Level death mage 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target is covered in armor that seems to eat light.

The target gains a +4 deflection bonus to their AC.

This AC bonus increases by +1 for every three levels above 7th, to a maximum of +8 at 19th level. This armor does not impede sight or lower light levels, but it grants the target darkvision out to 60 ft. if they do not already possess it. The target also gains an additional +2 bonus to AC and to their saves against good or light effects. If the target is undead they also gain a +4 channel resistance.
